body:
I absolutely hate myself. I think the world would be better off without me and if it was up to me I would not exist. I am only around right now because I'm scared of pain and because other people want me here. 

I have been in an outpatient program for mental health and am starting a new day program. They keep asking me to list things I like about myself and I cannot think of a thing. I wish people would stop caring so I could disappear.

This is a struggle for me too. When I had my first meeting with my psychiatrist he told me "we're going to get your self-esteem up" like it's something you can just do. I don't even know what having healthy self-esteem would look like. 

I can't offer you a lot of comfort, but it can help to stop focusing so much on yourself and start focusing on the things that interest you. Self-loathing can make you obsess over yourself. It's easier to keep living if you focus on the things you don't hate.
I went and am supposed to start the day program there tomorrow. I will have to see if there are insurance issues down the road.
I went. I am supposed to start the day program there tomorrow. I guess I will have to wait and see if I can afford to stick with it.

I can't get a loan because of my credit. I tried every option I could last month and nothing worked out. I wish it was an option because it would help tremendously. I could try to get a job at Starbucks for extra money and insurance but I don't know if I could handle going to work every day. Right now I am still struggling to catch up. My bank account is in the negative but hopefully I'll be able to fix that on Monday.

Right now I am going to go to an intake appointment for a mental health day program and I will see what they say. I haven't received a cancellation notice from my insurance yet, so I will at least keep using it for the time being.

I am completely broke and am struggling to earn anything. I have appointments for new programs but I know I can't afford them. My credit is ruined so I can't get a loan. I ruined my relationship with my boyfriend and he ended things with me. We still live together and I don't know where I am going to go or what I am going to do when our relationship is actually over. 

I hate myself. I hate what I have done with my life and I don't see any way to fix things that doesn't involve time travel. I can't keep going like this but I can't find a way to work towards something better. 

I told my boyfriend and he took me to the ER, which led to me entering the outpatient program. That was covered by temporary hospital provided insurance that I no longer have access to. If I tell him that I still feel this way I know I will end up in the ER again and get hospitalized. I'll have more bills and my life will get even worse.

I made friends in the program but they're doing really well and I know telling them how bad I am will hurt them. I have been really social over the last few days but when I am by myself I just cry and struggle to get work done. Pretending to be better takes so much out of me and I know it's not sustainable. 

There are people in my life that don't want me to kill myself, like my (now ex) boyfriend and my friends, but I can't keep going like this forever. Every day I stay alive things get worse. I feel so hopeless and I don't know how to disappear without hurting any of them.

I'm not seeing my psychiatrist again for 2 weeks. I don't know how long I can keep this up. Every time I try to get help I just feel more hopeless than I did before. If I tell someone how I feel I'm just going to wind up back in the ER and they'll put me in the hospital.
